nom: THE ROUTE The Party Peel - At-Home Chemical Peel

avis.titre: Pricey but works with consistent use
avis.texte: During COVID I used this peel weekly. I found it gentle and easy to use. I even had a skin tag under my eye that I just lived with since college because I thought it was permanent, but about two months in to using this product, it fell off and didnt leave a scar or anything. This is a holy grail product for me! While I no longer use it weekly-just based on cost-i still bust it out when I get acne and it clears it up without drying out my skin or irritating it.

avis.titre: Love the Product, hate the lack of instructions
avis.texte: I like it. It's easy to use and feels nice. It's pretty and interesting enough that my ADHD brain actually remembers to use it on occasion. I like that there is no strong odor. But, seriously, would it kill them to put directions for use on the box or the product itself? Really?! The box even directs you to a website to get directions on use. So everytime you use it, unless your brain remembers from the previous time, you have to go look up the instructions. It adds an annoying extra step and feels like a cheap marketing ploy to bring more traffic to their site, where they hope something else will catch your eye for you to buy while you're already there. Ugh

I have been using The Route since they first launched over 4 years ago. The Party Peel is my favorite of the whole line. I usually use it once or twice per week, but used it 8 days in a row once. I got slight flaking on my forehead after 8 days. It is very mild, any skin type can benefit from this product. My skin glows after I wash it off. I wash my face in the shower 1st, apply the Party Peel, wait about 15 minutes, then rinse off in the shower. No mess! You must pump several times sometimes for the product to dispense.

So far underwhelmed and i agree with the previous review, this mask seems very gimmicky. No butning or tingling effect noted, just bubbly + foamy (like a hydrogen peroxide effect). Misleading as it claims "medical grade" peeling… i highly doubt this claim is true. Will see how my skin reacts/feels in a day or two, but so far i plan to return for refund.
there's no way for me to use it the pump does not work there is no tube inside to help get any out.
I fell in love with this peel because of how incredible my skin is afterwards. Radiant and lush.

avis.titre: I will always use this product
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product and take it everywhere with me. My face always feels so soft refreshed and I feel amazing every time!!

It's basically just a gold paste that kind of bubbled. It did NOTHING for my skin. No amount of time helped. The only thing it did was annoy me and make me self conscious about getting the gold on my white towels.

I love that you can almost instantly feel this bubbling and working, but you feel it working *gently*. When it is on my skin, it feels active, but not in a stinging way. And after it rinses off, my skin truly feels softer, and purified.
A quick skin pick me up. Gentle exfoliating without irritation. Left my skin clear and soft
I like the bubbling, feel like it really gets in the pores but then washing it off and the glitter everywhere is annoying… and tbh I don't really feel like it does much for my skin.

This is a very unique and fun product to use. It goes on extremely gold/metallic but begins oxygenating upon contact with skin and starts bubbling. It feels VERY satisfying on the skin; it has a distinct tactile sensation that I've never experienced with a skincare product before. The acids are very very mild and don't sting very much like glycolic acid would. There is an extremely mild tingle that is temporary. Skin is very smooth afterward. Overall I don't find this product to be "necessary" in anyone's routine. However; I absolutely love it and enjoy it. If you're a skincare collector with tons of acid products, don't be wasteful and buy another unnecessary product. This would make a great gift though, especially since it's expensive. I don't see a reason for most people to spend money on this, but it makes a great gift idea and has some novelty/fun surrounding it.
I got a sample and thought u would try it out, can't recommend enough really brings out inner glow!

I bought this based on the number of positive reviews because I was trying to get a peel without the chemical peel effects/downtime. Well, it seems like I won't be getting anything since the bottle that I received is not pumping out and it feels like it's empty. Now I have to pay to mail it back or take it to the store for a refund. Either way, I would be losing money and that's a total shame.

Dude this thing is like tin man level shiny gold on your face and immediately after dispensing it bubbles all over you face for a minute and then goes back to gold tin man! It really would be a fun party mask with friends! I could tell an immediate difference after the mask too. It felt like it actually exfoliated my skin became smooth and ready for moisture! Helped with my acne even! I felt like the oxygen bubbles cleaned my pores and exfoliated all my dead skin. Very cool mask, never seen/found anything like it!
The bottle seems empty. Too expensive to just be some bubbles. It did nothing for my face. Rrturned.

Got this as part of an Ipsy Glam bag (full size) and was pleasantly surprised as I had never previously heard or or tried this brand before and instantly had to find out where I could buy. You first apply and it's a bubbly tingly sensation and it dries to a gold mask. Rinse off and skin looks brighter and feels smoother. I like to them apply a nice hydrating brightening oil for a glowy face

I'm not quite sold on this product for the price. it bubbled up and felt like it was doing something, but then made my skin itchy. couldn't leave it on the whole 15 mins, as too irritating. I really wanted this product to work, as I love, love, love The Route Daytime and Nightime moisturizer and their Golden Rulw retinoid cream. I'm going to keep using this mask a few more times, but so far not impressed.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy again in fact just bought another one
avis.texte: In the morning after washing my face leave it on for 15 min leave my skin so soft & subtle it's amazing what it does to your skin
I love this peel! after one use, this transformed my skin. I would recommend this to everyone!
It is good but the price for a really small bottle not worth it.

It looks fun when applying. It bubbled very little and only on my left cheek so that was weird. I have cheaper masks that make my skin feel better so I don't see a real benefit to this besides looking like a golden goddess for 15min

The Party Peel was a complete game changer. I relived on the back of the bottle that once it's starts bubbling, rub the mask in more in order to activate to the full capacity of this mask. 11/10, definitely would recommend.
I bought this because it was a new product line and I'm a sucker for skincare. I loved this peel so much I ordered a daytime cream from them right after!

avis.titre: Good product while we're stuck at home for an exfoliation
avis.texte: It works well and doesn't seem to irritate my sensitive skin. However, it starts bubbling the minute you pump it out making it challenging to use as you do have to apply it, so I put it on the back of my hand and then applied; I lost some of it because it had bubbled and set before I could move all of it to my face. It's a relatively small bottle to begin with.

I purchased this based on the reviews. I was super excited to see that glowy complexion. The product feels light and you really cannot see how much product is in the bottle to begin with. Now as far as results...I didn't notice a difference in my skin. The formula did bubble up but as I was applying it...it bubbled. Also the only difference I noticed was my skin became more dry. Another thing is there is gold glitter residue. My face had bits of gold glitter. I even gave it another shot just to make sure but again 0 results other than my face being dried out.

Not seeing extended results, this is just like any other tony moly "fun" mask which is cute for pics. There are more effective peels for sensitive skin such as FAB. I'm not seeing any resurfacing benefits, very underwhelming at such a high price point.

The first time I used this it bubbled but it didn't the second time so I'm not sure what happened but without that sensation to me it's not working I also bought the Girlfriend which feels like bunch of silicone so sadly both will be going back. I was really excited to get these based off of

I got this peel as a sample. Oh my! It is so good and so fun. I love how it bubbles up and actually feels like it's working. I just wish it was a little less pricey. But for the experience it's worth it.

avis.titre: Where has The Route been all my life?!?
avis.texte: I have been using the The Route Golden Rule retinoid treatment and Girlfriend Glow Primer for a few months now and thought those products were amazing. Well... a girlfriend invited me over for a peel party using this product and I just can't believe the results. Beautiful, smooth, glowing skin!! It's a shame I had nowhere to go. Nurse Nancy and team... if you're reading this review... THANK YOU! You're products are amazing!

avis.titre: WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN ALL MY LIFE?
avis.texte: Actually gives me GLOWING skin - even my husband noticed the very first time I used it. I will NEVER be without this product - the BEST!

I have extremely sensitive skin (rosacea and acne prone as well) and am able to use this with no issues! I used it for the first time last night. I've left it on for 7 minutes and love how the little bubbles make you feel like you're seeing it work. The color is so fun and is a great way to see where you've applied the product for a more even distribution. My skin did not get pink from this and it felt very soft afterwards. The following day my skin was glowing!
Never thought a peel could be this fun and effective. It says you use it once or twice a week, but I'm inclined to use it everyday. My skin is glowing and with zero irritation. Hooray!!!!
